note: Judgments were written before any model was run. Each query is phrased the way an operator would ask, and deliberately avoids some of the words the relevant documents use, so it tests meaning rather than exact matching.

queries.query: equipment left on after the factory closes
queries.why: Documents say overnight, night, Sunday, after hours, shutdown, closures; few say factory or equipment.
Documents talk about bearings, vibration, worn windings, degradation, spindle.

queries.query: shift heavy loads to cheaper hours
queries.why: Documents say peak tariff window, off-peak, maximum demand, bill.
Documents say leak, leakage, blowing, base load; wastage itself is never used.
Documents say refrigeration, overheating, condenser, trip; hot and cooling plant are absent.

queries.query: machine switching on and off too often
queries.why: Documents say short-cycling, starts per hour, float switch, pressure switch.
KB15 uses the words; KB30 only says power factor correction and capacitor bank.
Documents say chamber, temperature rose, warm air infiltrate, heater energised.

queries.query: uneven current across the three phases
queries.why: Documents say phase imbalance, unbalanced, single-phase.
Documents say fouled condenser coils, iced coils, cleaning. KB35 (heat exchanger for heat recovery) shares the exact words but is not about fouling, so it is a trap for exact matching.
Documents say overheating, running hotter, temperature rose, heat the motor windings.
Documents say moulding machine, servo drives, excess current.
